documentTitle: Adventures of Ethan and Leo - The Lost Map

images.title: The Descent
images.alt: Ethan studies a glowing map while Leo raises a torch at the top of a wet spiral staircase descending beneath the island.
images.caption: Ethan and Leo begin the spiral descent into the island.

images.title: The Labyrinth
images.alt: Ethan kneels over the glowing map as Leo points through a vast maze of branching, spiral-carved stone tunnels.
images.caption: The map must guide the brothers through the labyrinth.

images.title: The Shifting Walls
images.alt: Carved stone walls grind and rotate around Ethan and Leo while the route on Ethan's glowing map changes.
images.caption: The living maze rearranges itself around the brothers.

images.title: The Illusion
images.alt: A glowing vision of the moonlit shore, their boat, and a treasure chest appears in the wall as Leo points Ethan back toward the real corridor.
images.caption: A beautiful illusion tries to lure Ethan away from the true path.

images.title: The Heart of the Maze
images.alt: Ethan and Leo enter an immense circular chamber filled with fallen carved stones and a tall spiral-marked monument.
images.caption: At last, the brothers reach the glowing heart of the maze.

images.title: The Awakening
images.alt: Golden and blue rings of light race across the ancient chamber as Ethan's map and Leo's torch blaze together.
images.caption: The chamber awakens in a whirl of starlight and spirals.

images.title: The Guardian's Return
images.alt: A towering ancient stone guardian with calm amber eyes rises from mist before Ethan and Leo in the cavern.
images.caption: The island's stone guardian returns to face the brothers.

images.title: The Final Trial
images.alt: Ethan and Leo stand side by side before the moss-covered guardian as a golden spiral path shines between them.
images.caption: Together, Ethan and Leo step forward for the final trial.

images.title: The Passage Beyond
images.alt: Ethan and Leo gaze into a newly opened passage filled with soft white-blue light between enormous spiral-carved doors.
images.caption: A hidden passage opens, revealing the way beyond the maze.
